scope: Independent non-author, offline arithmetic/classification/boundary review of the three-file Kyber9 patch. Not formal family_local closure or EVM acceptance.

findings.disposition: Existing fail-closed Exact guard retained. Raw marginal classification does not certify every amount/direction at extreme limits. Not claimed closed by this sample patch.

verdict: No confirmed new blocker in this patch scope; P3 test blind spot addressed by author. Not whole-family or formal merge acceptance.
